title: Listing Review Team Standard — Reinstatement Nights After a Safety Suspension (Listings)
content:
# Reinstatement Nights After a Safety Suspension

*Listing review team standard for Roamhaven Listings.*

Party-prevention nights sit on top of the standard minimum-stay floor and are worked out on the day of the change. **Reinstatement nights** are read from the most recent reinstatement request of the listing, for a suspension with reason **safety**, that the listing review team approved. Its age is counted in whole months from the date part of its decision moment to the day of the change.

| Most recent approved reinstatement after a safety suspension | Reinstatement nights |
|---|---|
| decided fewer than 12 whole months back | 2 nights |
| decided at least 12 and fewer than 24 whole months back | 1 night |
| no such approval, or the most recent one decided 24 whole months back or more | none |

## Reading notes

- Only requests for a suspension with reason safety count; an approved request lifting a quality, registration or host-account suspension is not read.
- Only approved requests count; a denied or still-submitted request is not read.
- Where the listing has more than one approved safety reinstatement, only the most recent is read.

## Edge readings (hypothetical decisions, change on 2026-06-15)

| Most recent approved safety reinstatement decided on | Whole months back | Reinstatement nights |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-06-16 | 11 | 2 nights |
| 2025-06-15 | 12 | 1 night |
| 2024-06-16 | 23 | 1 night |
| 2024-06-15 | 24 | none |
